title: The Secret of the Amazon River

scenes.text: Why does the Amazon River hide a secret?
It is home to millions of species, more than any other river on Earth.
scenes.label: RIVER HOSTS MILLIONS

scenes.text: Its average discharge exceeds 200,000 cubic meters per second, the largest of any river.
scenes.label: WORLD'S LARGEST DISCHARGE

scenes.text: At about 6,400 km long, it ranks as the second‑longest river after the Nile.
scenes.label: SECOND LONGEST RIVER

scenes.text: Follow for a mind-blowing fact every day.

description: The Amazon River isn't just massive—it hides astonishing facts about life, water, and length. Discover the hidden wonders and stay curious.
